findings.statement: CA9 transcripts in the tumour sit almost entirely in RCC cells (transcript share [gene=CA9; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.976]; RCC cells expressing [gene=CA9; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=54.7%]), and the RNA effect persists when extrapolated to a pure tumour [gene=CA9; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=7.787], so the bulk signal is tumour-intrinsic.

Paired by donor, tumour cells versus normal proximal tubule give [gene=CA9; type=sc_tumor_vs_pt; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; log2fc=7.739] with [gene=CA9; type=sc_tumor_vs_pt; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; padj=0.0189], consistent with a tumour-cell-specific hypoxia/HIF output rather than a lineage marker.

In Visium the composition-corrected in-situ expresser of CA9 is RCC ([gene=CA9; type=spatial_summary; source=DATASET:LI2022-VISIUM; in_situ_expressers.0.composition_corrected_share=0.999]); high-CA9 spots are enriched for RCC neighbours ([gene=CA9; type=spatial_summary; source=DATASET:LI2022-VISIUM; enriched_neighbors.0.log2_enrichment=0.381]) and, more weakly, macrophages ([gene=CA9; type=spatial_summary; source=DATASET:LI2022-VISIUM; enriched_neighbors.1.log2_enrichment=0.099]). Spatial estimates depend on deconvolution.

The CA9 AlphaFold model has whole-model [gene=CA9; type=alphafold_model; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=76.56]. Its top cavity has volume [gene=CA9; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=126.8], pocket-lining [gene=CA9; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=90.3] and structural-context score [gene=CA9; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; structural_context_score=0.546]. Coverage of experimental ligand contacts by detected cavities is [gene=CA9; type=ligand_site_validation; source=PDBe-KB ligand sites (experimental holo structures); recall=0.5]. This is a monomer heuristic and does not identify a degron, ligase compatibility or degradation.

CD70 is strongly tumour-up in TCGA ([gene=CD70; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=7.0902]) and the effect persists at full tumour purity ([gene=CD70; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=4.278]), so bulk elevation is not just infiltration. It already has early-phase clinical antibodies, so this is repurposing rather than novelty, and single-cell data show some lymphocyte expression, so it is not exclusive to RCC cells.

KDR transcripts are held by endothelium (transcript share [gene=KDR; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.951]; endothelial cells expressing [gene=KDR; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=40.5%]), and RCC contributes almost nothing in situ ([gene=KDR; type=spatial_summary; source=DATASET:LI2022-VISIUM; in_situ_expressers.1.composition_corrected_share=0.002]). It is a microenvironment (anti-angiogenic) target, not a tumour-cell target.

CD74 is expressed by nearly all antigen-presenting cells (cDC cells expressing [gene=CD74; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=cDC; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=100.0%]), and macrophages hold the largest transcript share ([gene=CD74; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Macrophage; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.436]). It is an immune-cell marker, not a tumour-cell target.

CXCR4 is expressed by lymphocytes (CD4 T cells expressing [gene=CXCR4; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=CD4_T; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=87.8%]; CD8 T transcript share [gene=CXCR4; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=CD8_T; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.563]), so it is an immune-infiltrate target and not tumour-intrinsic.

EPAS1 (HIF-2a) is mainly endothelial per cell (endothelial per-cell level [gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; cpm_share=0.626]), while RCC cells hold little of its tumour transcripts ([gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.051]; RCC cells expressing [gene=EPAS1; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=4.9%]). Bulk EPAS1 signal therefore largely reflects endothelium and fibroblasts, although droplet dropout limits this reading.

MET is mainly tumour-cell derived (RCC transcript share [gene=MET; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.935]; RCC cells expressing [gene=MET; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=35.2%]), with a minor endothelial per-cell component ([gene=MET; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Endothelial; tissue=tumor; cpm_share=0.283]).

EGFR transcripts are mainly in RCC cells (transcript share [gene=EGFR; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.948]; RCC cells expressing [gene=EGFR; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=RCC; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=29.7%]), a tumour-intrinsic rather than stromal pattern, but expression is sparse per cell.

Tumour track: COL23A1 is carried by RCC cells (source-group transcript share [gene=COL23A1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; source_share=0.881]), has few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, is surface/secreted with antibody and protein modalities, and its maximum vital-organ expression is low (heart muscle, [gene=COL23A1; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; vital_max_ntpm=3.0] nTPM). It is up in TCGA ([gene=COL23A1; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=5.8291]), holds at full purity ([gene=COL23A1; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=4.88]) and carries no adverse prognosis ([gene=COL23A1; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=-0.123]). Hypothesis only: no selective dependency was found, and normal-tissue protein staining and heterogeneity across tumour cells are untested; literature is counted by gene symbol.

The COL23A1 AlphaFold model is low confidence ([gene=COL23A1; type=alphafold_model; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=58.91]) and its only cavity is tiny ([gene=COL23A1; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=8.0]; score [gene=COL23A1; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; structural_context_score=0.2342]), so the model gives no support for a small-molecule route. An antibody against an extracellular domain is the more plausible modality; low scores do not exclude other modalities.

Tumour track: RAB42 is carried by RCC cells (source-group transcript share [gene=RAB42; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=tumor; source_share=0.627]), with very few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. It is up in TCGA ([gene=RAB42; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=4.371]), holds at full purity ([gene=RAB42; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=3.189]) and shows no prognostic signal ([gene=RAB42; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.058]). Caveats: it is a small GTPase annotated as surface/secreted, which needs checking, and there is no dependency evidence. Its top cavity has volume [gene=RAB42; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=37.4] within a model of [gene=RAB42; type=alphafold_model; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=85.31].

Stroma track: OLFML2A is carried by fibroblasts (transcript share [gene=OLFML2A; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Fibroblast; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.647]; fibroblasts expressing [gene=OLFML2A; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Fibroblast; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=38.3%]), with few ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. It is up in TCGA ([gene=OLFML2A; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=2.372]), holds at full purity ([gene=OLFML2A; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=1.527]) and has no adverse prognosis ([gene=OLFML2A; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=-0.155]). It is a microenvironment candidate, not tumour-cell derived, with notable colon expression ([gene=OLFML2A; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=stroma; vital_max_ntpm=27.9] nTPM); dependency and function in the tumour are unknown.

Stroma track: JAG2 is attributed to endothelium (source-group transcript share [gene=JAG2; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=stroma; source_share=0.487]), with a modest number of ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. It is up in TCGA ([gene=JAG2; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=1.549]) and holds at full purity ([gene=JAG2; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=1.061]). Caveats: modest effect size, a Notch-ligand role that is not tumour-cell, and heart-muscle expression ([gene=JAG2; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=stroma; vital_max_ntpm=12.7] nTPM).

Immune track: GAL3ST4 is carried by macrophages (transcript share [gene=GAL3ST4; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Macrophage; tissue=tumor; share_of_tumor_transcripts=0.972]; macrophages expressing [gene=GAL3ST4; type=sc_celltype_expression; source=DATASET:LI2022-SCRNA; cell_group=Macrophage; tissue=tumor; pct_expressing=23.7%]), with a single ccRCC paper and no clinical drug. It is up in TCGA ([gene=GAL3ST4; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=2.993]) but the effect shrinks at full purity ([gene=GAL3ST4; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.401]), and higher expression goes with worse survival ([gene=GAL3ST4; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.177]). It is a macrophage-state hypothesis; function and surface protein are unvalidated.

The GAL3ST4 model has whole-model [gene=GAL3ST4; type=alphafold_model; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=79.31] and a large deep cavity (volume [gene=GAL3ST4; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; volume_a3=819.7]; pocket-lining [gene=GAL3ST4; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; mean_plddt=92.8]; score [gene=GAL3ST4; type=structural_context; source=DATASET:ALPHAFOLD-DB; structural_context_score=0.7874]), the highest structural-context score among the candidates examined. This is a monomer heuristic only, with no degron, ligase or degradation inference.

Immune track: LILRB4 is macrophage-attributed (source-group transcript share [gene=LILRB4; type=discovery_profile; source=Europe PMC + Open Targets + UniProt + CPTAC + scRNA-seq; track=immune; source_share=0.933]) with no clinical drug, but its bulk TCGA rise largely vanishes at full purity ([gene=LILRB4; type=purity; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PURITY; rna_lfc_at_purity1=0.508]) and it is flagged infiltration-driven and not purity-robust. Treat it as a myeloid immune-checkpoint hypothesis, not a tumour-intrinsic one.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses; none has dependency or functional evidence, and literature is counted by gene symbol.
Structural-context scores describe predicted monomer cavities, not degrons, ligase compatibility or degradation; low scores do not exclude molecular-glue feasibility.
Single-cell data cover few donors; endothelium and fibroblasts are small populations, and EPAS1 dropout limits tumour-cell attribution.
CD70 single-cell attribution is not quoted with numbers here; the earlier run showed it differs between cohorts.

The convergence top ranks are dominated by loss-in-tumour kidney genes (ALDOB, SLC22A8, UMOD, FABP1, NPHS2, PIGR), which are tissue-state biomarkers, not targets; SCARB1 and NNMT were not profiled at single-cell level here.
